profile_text.body:
IBM, founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY, is a publicly traded technology company (NYSE: IBM) that reported revenue of $67,535,000,000 for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2025. The company's website focuses on IBM OpenPages, which it describes as a scalable, AI-powered governance, risk, and compliance platform available on any cloud or on-premises. OpenPages offers a modular approach to GRC, covering risk management, compliance, and internal audit functions in a single integrated solution, with embedded AI that the company says automates classification, issue creation, and risk management tasks. The platform supports integration with watsonx.ai or third-party AI models through an API-based architecture, and includes an OpenPages MCP Server designed to allow AI agents to create, query, and update GRC objects within governed workflows.

IBM tracks two additional AI governance products on this site. IBM watsonx.governance is described as an AI lifecycle governance platform covering model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation, with accelerators for EU AI Act compliance, and was named a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026. IBM watsonx is characterized as a broader enterprise AI platform that is model-agnostic and incorporates agent inventory, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection capabilities through its governance layer. IDC recognized IBM as a leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment, according to the company's site. Citi is cited as a customer that partnered with IBM to automate its internal audit process using AI and machine learning.

The held facts show no litigation on record for IBM in this site's dataset. IBM holds a CIK of 0000051143 with the SEC, consistent with its status as a public company filing on Form 10-K.
